title: Grounding report v1
description: The `--output` of `eval score grounding`: reference-free grounding and citation metrics of the context-arm answers (no model call). Only `with_docs` answers that have retrieved context are scored.

run_id.description: The envelope: the id of the run that saved this file (dokimi.artifacts.run_id). Absent from files saved before the envelope.

dokimi_version.description: The envelope: the dokimi version that saved this file. Absent from files saved before the envelope.

summary.description: `grounding_score` (mean with a bootstrap CI, or null), `citation_rate`, `threshold` and `n_evaluated`.
